headline: Foggy mornings, mild afternoons through Thursday, then wind and light rain Friday-Saturday.
summary: A mild pattern dominates through Thursday. Each night and morning brings low clouds and fog, densest inland and around the Olympics, and a fog advisory is possible tonight. Afternoons turn sunny, warming slowly to the low 70s in a few spots by Thursday. A weather system arrives Friday, with gusty winds ahead of it and light rain into Saturday, amounts only a tenth to a quarter inch. Forecasters are fairly confident in the mild pattern but less sure about the system, as models only partly agree on a trough, a dip in the jet stream, moving through. Colder air follows this weekend into early next week, with light snow possible on mountains above about 4,500 feet and possible frost in the foothills, though frost confidence is low.
